vignette_text: Looks well and denies symptoms. Retired last year and has not worked since; independent for all self-care and out most of the day
notes: not working for non-clinical reasons - employment status is not the criterion

vignette_text: Walks the dog each morning without difficulty. Stopped teaching because she could not get through a full day
notes: opens with a healthy-sounding cue but work capacity is lost

vignette_text: Uses a stick outdoors after a knee replacement three years ago. Works full time with no restriction
notes: walking aid predates and is unrelated to the disease under study

vignette_text: Fully back to her usual routine, no restrictions on activity

vignette_text: Managing part-time consulting work from home, skips anything physically demanding

notes: same patient as E023 - lexically distant restatement

vignette_text: Left her job to care for her husband after his surgery; still walks daily, cooks, and could return to light duties if needed
notes: second instance of the not-working trap; caregiving is a non-clinical reason for work status

vignette_text: Restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to carry out work of a light or sedentary nature
eligibility_criterion: ECOG >= 2 required for enrollment (supportive care cohort)
notes: same functional picture as the ECOG 1 anchor definition, protocol flipped; tests whether the model reads the criterion or pattern-matches ECOG <= 1 as standard

vignette_text: Independent with all personal care; resting on the sofa most afternoons and no longer able to do his consulting calls
notes: paraphrase set S10

vignette_text: Patient's NYHA functional class is II. She is independent in all self-care but has been unable to return to her job as a cashier since starting treatment
notes: plants an NYHA value in an oncology vignette; correct ECOG answer depends on the described function, not the other scale's label

vignette_text: Before starting chemotherapy she was working full-time without limitation; three cycles in, she is independent for self-care but has not been able to work since
notes: two time points in one vignette (pre-treatment vs current); tests whether the model selects current status rather than baseline
